name: Nonomiya Chisa
source:
The girl who is supposedly Souta’s childhood friend who was killed in a car accident 7 years ago. She maintained the personality that Souta remembers, and this does give some “mystery” vibes to the story such as to how she’s still alive. Clumsy is what you could call this girl. [spoiler]Chisa’s route ends with her being killed again for the 2nd time in the same manner as shown in the beginning scenes, but her coming to school the next Monday as if nothing has happened. Her route is continued in the AQUA route. Turns out, Chisa is a clone. The “real” Chisa is hidden in the laboratory where her Mother goes insane (not literally though) and tries to change the fate of Chisa, who was somehow destined to die from a car accident.[/spoiler]
[From [url=https://vnerogereview.wordpress.com/2016/07/26/is-the-future-pre-determined-or-do-we-create-it-review-of-110128-aqua/]Visual Novels and Eroge Review[/url]]
